query.name: com.classdojo.users
query.sql:
with yearquery as (select id, abbreviation from terms where portion = 1 AND terms.lastday > sysdate AND sysdate > terms.firstday-30 AND schoolid=0 ), TeacherorgSource as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.status = 1 and schoolstaff.staffstatus = 1 and schoolstaff.schoolid != users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceh as (select users.dcid as dcid, case cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) when '0' then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else cast(schoolstaff.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) end as SchoolID from users join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid ), TeacherorgSourceGroup as (select users.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(TeacherorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY TeacherorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from users join (select * from TeacherorgSourceh) TeacherorgSourceh on TeacherorgSourceh.dcid = users.dcid left join (select * from TeacherorgSource) TeacherorgSource on TeacherorgSource.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid and schoolstaff.schoolid = users.homeschoolid
group by users.dcid, TeacherorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentorgSource as (select distinct students.dcid, cc.schoolid from students join cc on students.id = cc.studentid join yearquery on 1=1 join sections on cc.sectionid = sections.id join teachers t on sections.teacher=t.id and t.ptaccess = 1 and t.status = 1 and t.StaffStatus = 1 where students.enroll_status = 0 and cc.schoolid != students.schoolid and (cc.termid between yearquery.id and yearquery.id+99) and cc.dateleft > cc.dateenrolled ), StudentorgSourceh as (select students.dcid, students.schoolid from students ), StudentorgSourceGroup as (select students.dcid, case when (LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) is null then cast(StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID as varchar2(10)) else StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID||','||(LISTAGG(StudentorgSource.SchoolID, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY StudentorgSource.SchoolID)) end as orgSourcedIds from students join (select * from StudentorgSourceh) StudentorgSourceh on StudentorgSourceh.dcid = students.dcid left join (select * from StudentorgSource) StudentorgSource on StudentorgSource.dcid = students.dcid
group by students.dcid, StudentorgSourceh.SchoolID ), StudentEmail as (select psc.email as email, stu.dcid as dcid from PSM_STudentcontact psc join psm_studentcontacttype psct on psc.studentcontacttypeid = psct.id and psct.name = 'Self' join sync_studentmap ssm on psc.studentid = ssm.studentid join students stu on ssm.studentsdcid = stu.dcid ), studenttocontact as (select students.dcid, person.id from students join studentcontactassoc on students.dcid = studentcontactassoc.studentdcid join person on studentcontactassoc.personID = person.id join PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT on person.id = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.CONTACTPERSONID and studentcontactassoc.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTCONTACTASSOCID and students.dcid = PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.STUDENTDCID left join GuardianPersonAssoc on person.id = GuardianPersonAssoc.PersonID left join guardian on guardianpersonassoc.guardianid = guardian.guardianid left join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and Guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where (PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.ISCUSTODIAL = 1 or PSSIS_STU_CONTACT_ACT.LIVESWITHFLG = 1 OR GuardianStudent.GuardianID is not null) and students.enroll_status in (0,-1) ), studenttocontactGroup as (select students.dcid, -- listagg() creates comma-separated aggregate list for all linked contacts, then replace() removes those that don't have an account case when (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) = 'C' then null else (replace(listagg('C'||studenttocontact.id,',') within group (ORDER BY students.dcid),'C,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from students left join (select * from studenttocontact ) studenttocontact on studenttocontact.dcid = students.dcid Group by students.dcid ), guardiantostudents as (select guardian.guardianid, studentcontactassoc.studentdcid from guardian join pcas_account on GUARDIAN.accountidentifier = pcas_account.pcas_accounttoken left join pcas_emailcontact on pcas_account.pcas_accountID = pcas_emailcontact.pcas_accountid left join guardianpersonassoc on guardian.guardianid = guardianpersonassoc.guardianid left join studentcontactassoc on guardianpersonassoc.personID = studentcontactassoc.personID left join students on students.DCID = studentcontactassoc.studentdcid join GuardianStudent on students.dcid = GuardianStudent.StudentsDCID and guardian.guardianid=GuardianStudent.GuardianID where guardianpersonassoc.PersonID is not null ), guardiantostudentGroup as (select guardian.guardianid, case when (replace(listagg('S'||guardiantostudents.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY guardian.guardianid),'S,','')) = 'S' then null else (replace(listagg('S'||guardiantostudents.studentdcid,',') within group (ORDER BY guardian.guardianid),'S,','')) end as agentSourcedIds from guardian left join (select * from guardiantostudents) guardiantostudents on guardiantostudents.guardianid = guardian.guardianid group by guardian.guardianid ), guardiantostudentSchool as (select guardian.guardianid, case when (listagg(students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY guardian.guardianid)) is null then cast((select prefs.value from prefs where prefs.name = 'districtnumber') as varchar2(10)) else (listagg(students.schoolid,',') within group (ORDER BY guardian.guardianid)) end as orgSourcedIds from guardian join (select * from guardiantostudents) guardiantostudents on guardiantostudents.guardianid = guardian.guardianid join students on students.dcid = guardiantostudents.studentdcid group by guardian.guardianid ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by IsPreferred DESC,PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 0 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL and PhoneType != 'Mobile' ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand as (select PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.PhoneType from PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group where PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand_Group.rn = 1 ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group as (select PSSIS_Person_Phone.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_Phone.PhoneType, row_number () over ( partition by PersonID order by IsPreferred DESC,PhoneNumberPriorityOrder ASC ) rn from PSSIS_Person_Phone where ISSMS = 1 and PhoneNumberExt IS NULL and PhoneType = 'Mobile' ), PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS as (select PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PersonID, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumber, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneNumberExt, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.PhoneType from PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group where PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS_Group.rn = 1 ) -- teachers select 'T'||users.dcid as sourcedId, TeacherorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'teacher' as role, users.first_name as givenName, users.last_name as familyName, users.email_addr as email, null as agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, null as primary_language from users left join (select * from TeacherorgSourceGroup) TeacherorgSourceGroup on TeacherorgSourceGroup.dcid = users.dcid join schoolstaff on schoolstaff.users_dcid = users.dcid left join teachers on teachers.users_dcid = users.dcid AND teachers.schoolId = users.homeSchoolId where users.homeschoolid = schoolstaff.schoolid and BITAND(schoolstaff.status, schoolstaff.staffstatus)+0 = 1
union all
-- students select 'S'||students.dcid as sourcedId, StudentorgSourceGroup.orgSourcedIds, 'student' as role, students.first_name as givenName, students.last_name as familyName, StudentEmail.email as email, studenttocontactGroup.agentSourcedIds, null as guardian_sms, null as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, case when students.grade_level <= -3 then 'IT' when students.grade_level between -2 and -1 then 'PK' when students.grade_level = 0 then 'KG' when students.grade_level between 1 and 13 then trim(to_char(students.grade_level,'00')) when students.grade_level > 13 then 'PS' else 'Other' end as grades, null as primary_language from students join schools on students.schoolid = schools.school_number -- School join graph join (select * from StudentorgSourceGroup) StudentorgSourceGroup on StudentorgSourceGroup.dcid = students.dcid -- student email join graph left join (select * from StudentEmail) StudentEmail on StudentEmail.dcid = students.dcid -- multi-guardian join graph join (select * from studenttocontactGroup) studenttocontactGroup on studenttocontactGroup.dcid = students.dcid where students.enroll_status in (0,-1)
union all
-- Contacts select 'C'||person.id as sourcedId, -- contacttostudentSchool.orgSourcedIds, null as orgSourcedIds, 'guardian' as role, person.firstname as givenName, person.lastname as familyName, -- pcas_emailcontact.emailaddress as email, null as email, -- guardiantostudentGroup.agentSourcedIds, null as agentSourcedIds, PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS.PhoneNumber as guardian_sms, PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand.PhoneNumber as guardian_phone, null as staff_sms, null as staff_phone, null as grades, null as primary_language from person -- join (select * from contacttostudentSchool) contacttostudentSchool on contacttostudentSchool.personid = person.id -- join (select * from contacttostudentGroup) guardiantostudentGroup on guardiantostudentGroup.personid = person.id join studentcontactassoc on person.id = studentcontactassoc.personID join StudentContactDetail on studentcontactassoc.StudentContactAssocID = StudentContactDetail.StudentContactAssocID join students on studentcontactassoc.studentdcid = students.dcid LEFT JOIN PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS ON PSSIS_Person_PhoneSMS.PersonID = person.id LEFT JOIN PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand ON PSSIS_Person_PhoneLand.PersonID = person.id where person.IsActive = 1
